# ULX patch bundle (optional — NOT deployed to install root)

**Do not use while lifepunch.ulx is unpinned on the Dev gamemode.**

`Patch-LifepunchnetUlxCompile.ps1` and `vendor/ulx-shared/` exist only for the rare case where ULX is pinned but portal shipped a 6-file bundle. Run manually from the git clone — never part of `start_dev_server.bat` or `Run-DevServer.ps1`.

Default lifepunchnet path: Steam + `dotnet run dxrp-server.cs` + dev token only.
